Sandbox_STA_EngineRebuild_MinMechanicsLe: Extra Mechanics levels required to rebuild an engine; based off of Engine Repair Level.
Sandbox_STA_EngineRebuild_EnginePartsReq: Engine Parts required to rebuild an engine per level of mechanics required.
Sandbox_STA_EngineRebuild_MinEngineCondi: Minimum engine condition required to rebuild the engine.
Sandbox_STA_EngineRebuild_EnableIncremen: Enable partial rebuilds rather than a full rebuild.
Sandbox_STA_EngineRebuild_EngineIncremen: Amount Engine Quality will increase when Incremental Rebuilds is enabled.
